title: Vorrichtung und Verfahren zur Spracherkennung
abstract: The device and method of the invention involve automatically designating a scope of a partial reference pattern. Plural reference patterns, each of which ends in each of composing frames and starts from a preceding frame, are supposed and cumulative distances at every frame are calculated. A partial reference pattern that has a minimal distance value as compared with all other partial patterns is taken as a partial input speech recognizing result.
